notes.title: Supermarket Simulator Celebrates one year since launch!
notes.content:
[h2]We’re taking a look back at where Supermarket Simulator started and where it is now[/h2]

It’s already been one entire year since the launch of Supermarket Simulator in Early 
Access!

As with most games, we didn’t begin exactly with what you see today. Supermarket Simulator started from humble beginnings as a passion project by a single developer. Even the name was different, first appearing as Market Simulator before becoming what it is today. 

For a long time, it was a one-man show, until eventually the scope of the project grew and eventually a solo dev became an indie studio: Nokta Games.

To really get a scope of how much has been worked on in the span of just a year we made a timeline - and this does not include the many patches along the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/ef39aa3989d27c5e44212ba513e9819f08f6e4ac.png[/img]

Looking back we couldn’t have predicted how far a year would take us, so we had to celebrate. Enjoy 30% off during our Anniversary Sale started yesterday until the 27th, with big announcements and a special AMA. Keep your eyes out for those and from the bottom of our hearts thank you to everyone who showed such amazing support last year! 

We couldn’t have done it without you and are excited to continue to improve Supermarket Simulator. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: DevLog #2
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/xWD5BfNMMM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/122a4bdecba327053fe91125b76cb0ee9dfb75a1.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Updates[/h1]

Welcome! Here's DevLog #2: The customers!

[h2]Customers[/h2]
We added customers to the game! There is a diverse customer pool. 

[h3]Customer AI[/h3]
Customers are not gonna buy everything you try to sell. They have preferences! You have to set the price perfectly for the correct product. You also need to level up for more customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/958ba35df729cf1ea885a5e34937b26b2a5acd5b.gif[/img]
[h3]Animations[/h3]
Worked more on customers' animations than planned for better results. There is a variety of animations.

[h3]Finally In Queue For Checkout[/h3]
People who finished shopping now queue in front of the checkout and wait for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/1ecad9a764484ca0bda025f10337acba732d20d2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Products[/h2]
Added a variety of products to sell! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/4c1cd372066ba3fd371d12144d4757987cba3c90.jpg[/img]

[h3]Product Licenses[/h3]
Added supermarket licenses for selling more products. You'll need to level up and pay for the license you want to be able to sell more items.

[h2]Warning Notifications[/h2]
Added warning notifications that'll help you run your supermarket smoothly. You'll need to keep an eye on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/369229189d95e34c1eda4ab6072261456f43f7f0.png[/img]

notes.title: DevLog #1
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/xWD5BfNMMM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/122a4bdecba327053fe91125b76cb0ee9dfb75a1.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Updates[/h1]

Welcome! Here's DevLog #1: Polishing, interaction, physics, save system, fixes, and more...

[h3]Interaction[/h3]
Added a highlighting system for objects to be interacted with. Boxes also can be placed, emptied, and refilled now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/8d88fa6b0f8133caea257f0ce25ada7129a1958f.gif[/img]

[h3]Placing-Taking items[/h3]
Added animations to place and take from shelves. The interaction is now performed by holding down mouse buttons instead of clicking each time. Added item-shelf type matching. You can only place items onto the matching type of shelves; Rack, Fridge, Freeze, etc.

[h3]Trash bin[/h3]
You can now throw unwanted items into the trash bins. But be careful :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/d137bd035989a3ddf5b56275978fa8efeaeefc19.gif[/img]

[h3]Aiming[/h3]
Added aim indicator, well needed.

[h3]Save system[/h3]
Added save system. Well needed as well :D

[h3]Pricing[/h3]
Added validation for price input. Polished the pricing screen. You can clearly see the profit now. Again, be careful :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/ed0fb9095b0e1404c644c2ca8de026fec84662b0.gif[/img]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
Fixed not being able to jump from some objects, and being able to move while in interaction with UI.

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
Added a pooling system for objects for the sake of optimization.

[h2]ADD TO WISHLIST[/h2]
